scenario.zh: 日常前端开发：组件编写、样式调整、小步重构。
scenario.en: Day-to-day frontend: components, styling, incremental refactors.

note.zh: 主 C，负责复杂组件与跨文件改动。
note.en: Main carry for complex components and cross-file edits.

note.zh: 副 C，处理重复性小任务，控制成本。
note.en: Sub carry for repetitive small tasks to keep cost down.

rotation.zh: 先由主 C 拆解需求出方案 → 副 C 批量执行 → 主 C 终审合入。
rotation.en: Main carry plans → sub carry executes in batch → main carry reviews and merges.

budgetAlt.zh: 全队换 Spark Lite 2，速度换成本，适合非关键路径。
budgetAlt.en: Swap the whole team to Spark Lite 2 for non-critical work.
